title: Weekend on City Radio
instructions: Bir radyo sunucusu hafta sonu hava durumunu ve şehirdeki etkinlikleri anlatıyor. En uzun metin; günleri, saatleri ve "usually / but" ifadesini dikkatle dinle. Bu sette 3 dinleme hakkın var.

script.speaker: host
script.text: Good morning, and welcome to City Radio. Here's your guide to the weekend.

script.speaker: host
script.text: First, the weather. On Saturday morning it's going to be cloudy, and in the afternoon there's going to be some rain.

script.speaker: host
script.text: But don't worry. Sunday is going to be sunny and warm, with a top temperature of twenty-two degrees.

script.speaker: host
script.text: Now, what's on in town? On Saturday, the food market is open from eight in the morning to two in the afternoon, in Market Square.

script.speaker: host
script.text: Usually the market is on Sundays, but this week it's on Saturday because of the bike race.

script.speaker: host
script.text: The city bike race starts at ten o'clock on Sunday morning at the river.

script.speaker: host
script.text: Many roads in the centre are closed from nine to one, so please take the train or the bus.

script.speaker: host
script.text: On Sunday evening, there's a free concert in Central Park. It starts at seven.

script.speaker: host
script.text: Children under twelve can go to the City Museum for free all weekend.

script.speaker: host
script.text: That's all from me. Have a great weekend!

questions.prompt: What is the weather going to be like on Saturday afternoon?
questions.feedback: Cumartesi sabah bulutlu (cloudy), öğleden sonra yağmurlu (rain). Güneşli olan pazar.
questions.evidence: in the afternoon there's going to be some rain.

questions.prompt: Why is the market on Saturday this week?
questions.feedback: Pazar genelde (usually) pazar günü kurulur ama bu hafta bisiklet yarışı (bike race) yüzünden cumartesi.
questions.evidence: but this week it's on Saturday because of the bike race.

questions.prompt: When are the roads in the centre closed?
questions.feedback: Yollar dokuzdan bire (from nine to one) kapalı. "Eight to two" pazarın açık olduğu saatler.

questions.prompt: What time does the concert start?
questions.feedback: Konser pazar akşamı yedide (at seven). On, yarışın başlama saati.

questions.prompt: How much does a ten-year-old child pay at the museum?
questions.feedback: On iki yaş altı çocuklar hafta sonu boyunca ücretsiz (for free). Beş pound yetişkinlerin ücreti.
questions.evidence: Children under twelve can go to the City Museum for free all weekend.
